const text = 'hello';
console.log(text.padStart(1000001, ''), text.padEnd(Infinity, ''));
console.log(text.padEnd(8, 'xy'));

console.log('😀'[0], '😀'.charAt(1), '😀');
console.dirxml('😀'[0]);

console.log(typeof Math.random, console.time.name, typeof RegExp.prototype.compile);
function readNumber(value: unknown) {
  console.log(Number(value));
}
function sample() {}
readNumber(sample);
console.log('%d', sample);
Object.defineProperty(sample, 'toString', { value: () => '5' });
readNumber(sample);

function printValues(items: (string | number)[], visible: boolean) {
  const allText = items.every((item) => typeof item === 'string') && visible;
  if (allText) console.log(items[0].toUpperCase());
}
printValues(['hello'], true);
printValues([1], true);
